tasks.description: Phase 1 — Planning & Design. Lock in scope for Phase 1. Covers all wizard steps, user roles, data fields, integrations.

comments.author: Jeff
comments.html:
MARKDOWN SPECS:

Here is the refreshed, complete Markdown requirements and specifications document for Phase 1, incorporating the borrower document list, upload guidance, and all previous details.
# Phase 1 Requirements & Technical Specifications

## 1. Project Overview
**Product Name**: [Your Chosen Name, e.g., LoanWizard / TurboLoan / EasySBA]

**Description**: A web-based guided SBA loan application platform that makes completing 7(a) and Express applications as easy and intuitive as TurboTax. The wizard collects information step-by-step, provides smart guidance, auto-fills where possible, generates basic pro formas, validates data, handles document uploads, and prepares exports or submissions for lenders.

**Target Users**:
- Primary: Small business owners / borrowers
- Secondary: Banks & credit unions (white-label / branded instances)

**Core Value**: Reduce time, errors, and frustration in SBA applications while delivering a delightful, trustworthy experience.

## 2. Tech Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 15 (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS
- **Hosting**: Vercel
- **Backend / Database / Auth**: Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions)
- **Emails**: Resend
- **Payments**: Stripe (Subscriptions + one-time fees)
- **Forms & Validation**: React Hook Form + Zod
- **UI**: shadcn/ui + Tailwind
- **AI Features**: Vercel AI SDK + OpenAI/Anthropic (suggestions, document insights, pro formas)
- **Analytics**: PostHog or Vercel Analytics

## 3. Key Features (Phase 1 MVP)

### Authentication & Onboarding
- Supabase Auth (email/password, magic links, optional social)
- Multi-tenant support for lender branding (subdomains or custom domains)
- Role-based access (Borrower vs. Lender Admin)

### Guided Application Wizard (TurboTax-Style)
- Multi-step stepper with progress bar, navigation, and save/resume functionality
- Auto-save every few seconds
- Conditional logic based on answers (e.g., show veteran questions or collateral sections)
- Clean, calm, professional UI with helpful explanations and tooltips

**Main Wizard Sections**:
1. Business Information
2. Ownership & Management (including veteran status)
3. Loan Request Details
4. Financial Information
5. Collateral & Additional Details (conditional)
6. Document Uploads
7. Review & Summary
8. Export / Submit

**Smart Features**:
- Real-time validation and error highlighting
- AI-assisted auto-fill and suggestions
- Basic pro forma / cash flow projection generation
- SBA program eligibility checker (including Veterans Advantage)

### Document Upload Section
Support secure uploads with clear guidance. Required/common documents include:

**Core / Always-Required**:
- SBA Form 1919 (Borrower Information Form)
- Personal Financial Statement (SBA Form 413 or equivalent)
- Business Tax Returns (last 2–3 years)
- Personal Tax Returns (last 2–3 years for owners/guarantors)
- Business Financial Statements (YTD P&L and balance sheet)
- Business Plan / Executive Summary with use of proceeds and projections
- Ownership Documents (operating agreement, articles, etc.)

**Financial & Debt**:
- Business Debt Schedule
- Aging Reports (AR/AP if applicable)
- Bank Statements (last 3–12 months)
- Cash Flow Projections / Pro Formas

**Identification & Background**:
- Photo ID for principals
- Resumes for owners/key management
- SBA Form 912 (if required by background questions)

**Collateral & Other (Conditional)**:
- Collateral Schedule and valuations
- Real estate documents (appraisals, leases, etc.)
- Business license, permits, franchise agreements, purchase agreements

**Upload Guidelines in Wizard**:
- Support PDF, JPEG, PNG, Excel/CSV
- Allow "Upload Later" with save/resume
- Provide "Why we need this" explanations and examples
- Conditional visibility based on loan type/answers
- Secure Supabase Storage with signed URLs

### Output & Lender Features
- Generate filled PDF forms and summary reports
- White-label branding for lenders
- Basic lender dashboard to view borrower applications

### Payments (Stripe)
- Lender subscriptions ($2,500/month base)
- Per-application fees ($250)
- Stripe Checkout, Customer Portal, and webhooks

## 4. Non-Functional Requirements
- **Performance**: Fast loads, responsive (mobile/tablet/desktop)
- **Security & Compliance**:
  - Encryption in transit (HTTPS) and at rest (Supabase defaults + column-level where needed)
  - Strong Row Level Security and access controls
  - Data minimization for sensitive info
  - Audit logging
  - Prepare for SOC 2 readiness
- **Accessibility**: WCAG 2.1 AA
- **Error Handling**: Friendly messages with recovery options

## 5. Design & UX Guidelines
- Style: Clean, modern, trustworthy (similar to TurboTax/Intuit)
- Tone: Helpful, encouraging, professional
- Mobile-first responsive design

## 6. Out of Scope for Phase 1
- Direct E-Tran submission (export only)
- Advanced underwriting
- Native mobile apps (Phase 2)
- Full SOC 2 audit

## 7. Success Metrics
- Wizard completion rate >60%
- High user satisfaction
- Time to complete <30–45 minutes for typical cases
- Successful pilots with early lenders

---

**Implementation Notes**:
- Prioritize the wizard UX as the core differentiator.
- Make document uploads modular and conditional.
- Build with multi-tenancy and white-labeling in mind from the start.

This spec is ready for implementation. Let me know if you want to expand any section (e.g., detailed database schema or user stories).

comments.html: NEXT STEPS — Supabase: Create a NEW PROJECT within your existing Supabase org (do not create a new account). Same billing, but fully separate Postgres instance, separate API keys, separate storage buckets — complete data isolation from JumpKit. Go to supabase.com → your org → New Project → name it PrepSBA. If PrepSBA later becomes its own entity, use Settings → General → Transfer Project to move it to a new org — no dump/restore needed as long as both orgs are on paid plans.

tasks.title: Configure X OAuth for PostKit auto-publishing
tasks.description:
Set up X (Twitter) Developer credentials to enable PostKit auto-publishing.

Steps:
1. Go to developer.x.com → sign in
2. Create a new Project + App
3. Under User Authentication Settings:
   - App type: Web App or Automated App
   - OAuth 2.0: ON
   - Redirect URI: http://localhost:8788/oauth/x/callback
   - Scopes: tweet.read, tweet.write, users.read, offline.access
4. Copy Client ID and Client Secret
5. Open PostKit (http://localhost:8788) → Settings → Connected Accounts
6. Paste Client ID and Client Secret → Save Settings
7. Click Connect X → authorize in popup → verify green checkmark
8. Test: create a root post → run Auri → schedule X post → click Publish Now

Note: Free X Developer tier allows posting. Rate limited but fine for personal/small use.

comments.author: Maximus
comments.html: X OAuth 2.0 PKCE flow fully built in PostKit (x-oauth.js). Server routes, token storage, scheduler worker, and UI all ready. Jeff just needs to create the X Developer project and paste credentials into Settings.

tasks.title: Add TikTok as auto-post platform in PostKit
tasks.description:
Add TikTok Content Posting API integration to PostKit alongside X, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

Proposal summary:
- API cost: Free (no per-post fees)
- Requires TikTok Developer app approval (1-4 week review)
- TikTok requires media on every post (no text-only) — pairs well with image generation

Work items:
1. tiktok-oauth.js — OAuth 2.0 flow (auth URL, callback, token exchange, refresh)
2. Server endpoints: /oauth/tiktok/callback, /api/tiktok/connect, /api/tiktok/publish, /api/tiktok/status, /api/tiktok/disconnect
3. Upload flow: 3-step TikTok process (init → binary chunk upload → publish)
4. Auri skill update — add TikTok platform, hook-first short-form captions
5. PostKit UI — TikTok tab in seed detail modal, platform chip, settings card (Client Key/Secret + Connect), scheduler worker
6. Action: Apply for TikTok Content Posting API access early so review is not the bottleneck

comments.author: Max

tasks.title: Add Facebook + Instagram as auto-post platforms in PostKit
tasks.description:
Add Meta Graph API integration to PostKit — one OAuth flow covers both Facebook Page posts and Instagram Business posts.

API cost: Free (no per-post fees)
Requires: Meta Business account + Business Verification (legal docs, 1-5 days) + App Review for pages_manage_posts permission (1-2 weeks)
Posting target: Facebook Page (not personal profile — Meta locked personal profile posting via API)

Work items:
1. facebook-oauth.js — OAuth 2.0 flow + Page access token exchange (permanent tokens available)
2. Server endpoints: /oauth/facebook/callback, /api/facebook/connect, /api/facebook/publish, /api/facebook/status, /api/facebook/disconnect
3. Post via /page-id/photos or /page-id/feed (text + image)
4. Instagram posts via /ig-user-id/media + /ig-user-id/media_publish (same app/auth, requires linked IG Business account)
5. Auri skill update — add Facebook platform (longer-form, community tone) and Instagram (visual-first, hashtag strategy)
6. PostKit UI — Facebook + Instagram tabs, platform chips, settings cards, scheduler workers

Settings needed from Meta Developer Portal:
- App ID + App Secret
- Facebook Page ID

Note: Apply for Meta Business Verification and pages_manage_posts App Review early — review is the main bottleneck.

comments.author: Max
comments.html: Queued after Jeff approved proposal (2026-07-07). Recommended priority: build after X + LinkedIn are validated in production. One Meta OAuth covers both FB and IG — highest value-per-effort of remaining platforms. Start Meta Business Verification early.

tasks.title: Add Bluesky as auto-post platform in PostKit
tasks.description:
Add Bluesky (AT Protocol) auto-posting to PostKit.

API cost: Free. No app review, no business verification, no gatekeeping — just an API key.
Audience: Tech/developer/IT — perfect overlap with JumpKit MSP and IT buyer persona.

Work items:
1. bluesky-auth.js — App password auth (simpler than OAuth: username + app password → session token)
2. Server endpoints: /api/bluesky/connect, /api/bluesky/publish, /api/bluesky/status, /api/bluesky/disconnect
3. Post via AT Protocol com.atproto.repo.createRecord (text + image embed)
4. Auri skill update — add Bluesky platform (similar to X but slightly longer, tech-forward tone)
5. PostKit UI — Bluesky tab, platform chip, settings card (handle + app password), scheduler worker

Note: Easiest platform to add. No review process. AT Protocol is open and well-documented. Handle is @user.bsky.social format.

comments.author: Max
